facts.note: Nine o'clock temple bell; watches shown; hers exact; doctor two minutes ahead; Girard would not take his out.
After dinner in the atelier beside the master; at ten the regulator agreed with the bell exactly.
Sent downstairs when the regulator showed 10:20; regulator running and master well.
Compared her watch with Rosa's clock; Rosa's clock exactly fifteen minutes fast.
Piano began 10:48 and stopped 11:01, both by the kitchen clock.
Went straight to the kitchen and stayed with Rosa until after the eleven o'clock strike.
